remarks: Lovely 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom condominium - Move in ready! Open concept living room and dining area with a balcony that overlooks the in-ground pool and beautiful park-like grounds. The Primary bedroom features a walk in closet. Private storage area. Full Size in-unit Washer and Dryer are located in the laundry closet off the foyer. Built-in air conditioning units. 1 Reserved Parking space with plenty off street additional parking for a second car or visiting guests. Walking distance to parks, medical facilities, and schools. Minutes to downtown, restaurants, nightlife, shopping, train station, Merritt Parkway and I-95. One month's security, first month's rent at lease signing.
